name: inspira-glowing-effect
blurb: Gradient border follows cursor around a container.
description: An absolute-positioned overlay that renders a glowing gradient border which rotates smoothly to point toward the cursor. Driven by pointer movement, with configurable spread, blur, and colour variants.
use_when: A card or container that should reward interaction with visual feedback as the user explores it.
avoid_when: Touch-only surfaces or when pointer tracking performance is a concern.
a11y: Purely visual overlay; pointer-events-none. No accessibility implications.
